activity.description: Source-code-driven extraction of 17 claims about ThermalMultiphaseOpenLB (JuliusWeinmiller/ThermalMultiphaseOpenLB@769efd4), an OpenLB extension for thermal single-component phase change multiphase flow. Each claim verified against actual source code in /tmp/ThermalMultiphaseOpenLB with file:line locators and verbatim quotes. Covers: Peng-Robinson/Carnahan-Starling EoS, modified Guo forcing, semi-hybrid thermal coupling, Maxwell construction, latent heat via EoS, MRT thermal solver, pool boiling, evaporating droplet, Laplace law, wall wettability, thermodynamic consistency, fluid properties, interaction potential, phase separation, d²-law, and OpenLB compatibility.

derived_from.description: OpenLB extension for thermal single-component phase change multiphase flow by Julius Weinmiller (master thesis, TU Delft)
